title: How to create a task and add it to a list
summary: Use the quick create button, fill the details, pick a list and save.

blocks.heading: Creating a task
paragraphs: Click the + (New task) button at the top of any screen to open the create panel. Pick which list it belongs to, give it a title, add any details (assignee, priority, due date), then click Create task.
The animation shows opening the create panel; the markings below point out the key fields.

blocks.caption: The create-task panel
blocks.alt: The create-task panel with the list picker, assignee, due date and Create task button highlighted
